Not a Damn Chicken

Not a Damn Chicken · Wilpattu National Park, Sri Lanka

Every time I bring someone to Sri Lanka, it happens. We are out in a national park when they spot this bird for the first time, and they turn to me, completely puzzled: "Why is there a chicken running around in a national park?"

And every time, I have to tell them the same thing.

It's not a damn chicken.

This is the Sri Lankan junglefowl, and it is far more special than any chicken. It is Sri Lanka's national bird, and it is endemic to the island, which means you will not find it living wild anywhere else in the world.

And just look at him. He is one of the prettiest birds in the park, painted in vibrant color from head to tail. His feathers shine in many shades at once, a whole rainbow of colors on one bird.

In the good seasons of the year, he looks even better. His coat grows full, fat and fluffy, which makes him look even more handsome, and, if I'm honest, a little bit cute.

So if you ever find yourself in a Sri Lankan national park and you spot a bird like this running around, please remember what I will forever be telling my guests.

It's not a damn chicken.
